tasks.label: ROS: build (docker)
tasks.command: docker exec myubuntu2004 bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/noetic/setup.bash && cd /root/catkin_ws && catkin_make'

tasks.label: ROS: launch v3 (rviz + 2 rqt)
tasks.command: docker exec -e DISPLAY=:0 myubuntu2004 bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/noetic/setup.bash && source /root/catkin_ws/devel/setup.bash && roslaunch final_text test_v3.launch'

tasks.label: ROS: launch v3 (no rqt)
tasks.command: docker exec -e DISPLAY=:0 myubuntu2004 bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/noetic/setup.bash && source /root/catkin_ws/devel/setup.bash && roslaunch final_text test_v3.launch open_rqt:=false'

tasks.label: ROS: launch v3_2 (rviz + 2 rqt)
tasks.command: docker exec -e DISPLAY=:0 myubuntu2004 bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/noetic/setup.bash && source /root/catkin_ws/devel/setup.bash && roslaunch final_text test_v3_2.launch'

tasks.label: ROS: stop all
tasks.command: docker exec myubuntu2004 bash -lc 'rosnode list 2>/dev/null | xargs -r rosnode kill; pkill -x rviz; pkill -x rqt_image_view; pkill -x rqt_reconfigure; pkill -f rosmaster'
